content: Work on VAE in BIBREF17 to learn acoustic embeddings conducted experiments using the TIMIT data set. In particular the tasks of phone classification and speaker recognition where chosen. As work here is an extension of such work we we follow the experimentation, however with significant extensions (see Section SECREF13). With guidance from the authors of the original workBIBREF17 our own implementation of VAE was created and compared with the published performance - yielding near identical results. This implementation then was also used as the basis for CJFS and CJFA, as introduced in § SECREF6.
